purpose: Prospective source-only general-letter development diagnostics and exact regression comparison of actual saved QGIS geometries.

runtime.native_thinning_backend: portable NumPy (QGIS runtime; no scikit-image acceleration)

comparison_options.input_policy: integer mouse events at exact native cell centres; matching inputs verified

source_provenance.scope: 15 previously raw-inspected unrouted native windows from two known validation maps, plus six new native windows from two previously unassigned raw-screened development families. Only two positive cases and two wrong-neighbor pairings were selected. Original Calibration/Holdout remained sealed.
source_provenance.rights: Public-domain U.S. Army Map Service maps; University of Texas Libraries scans. Exact source URLs, hashes, crop coordinates and rights snapshot hash are in the crop index.
source_provenance.raw_control_policy: Both agents checked physically dark source pixels, visible arms and neighboring lane order before first route/model/skeleton outputs. Hidden curves were never supplied to the product or scored.

preserved_initial_unsuccessful_probe.finding: Detector and correct connector were available in bundled QGIS Python, but existing visible-arm preservation kept Ink. Candidate availability did not establish a changed final trace.
preserved_initial_unsuccessful_probe.subsequent_change: Selected actual-glyph-ink contacts distinguish sustained glyph following from a shorter brief crossing, after the same genuine ends and visible arms are already preserved.

diagnostic_mechanism.detection: Two elongated cells in a compact branched ink body plus one independently aligned detached heading stroke. Exact actual source ink is distinct from the context hull.
diagnostic_mechanism.width_ranking: Text-only uncertainty for EDT radii1 versus sqrt(2); hard1.55 width-ratio gate, mutual uniqueness0.15 and crossing rejection remain.
diagnostic_mechanism.neighbor_safety: Text candidates require unbranched original visible prefix/suffix; a grid-junction escape toward a wrong contour is refused. Legacy numeric route defaults are unchanged.
diagnostic_mechanism.arbitration: Only after visible-arm preservation succeeds: old source-ink run>=8px, >=2*new run and >=4px longer; old actual-ink contact>=1.5*new and >=4px longer; old gap arc>=4px longer. Sampling is uniform native arclength, not vertex count.

repository_validation.ci_policy: GitHub Actions are checked after pushing the implementation on main.

limits: One black Hanja positive from one additional development map is evidence of this corrected example, not a population accuracy or generalization estimate.
The blue Latin-letter case was already good on the source-visible arms and is preserved; it is not an improvement result.
Visible F1@2px and p95 compare only separately observed source arms. The hidden curve remains unknown and unscored.
Wrong-neighbor cases check refusal of the optional inferred text connector. Ordinary routes for deliberately cross-contour user clicks are not scored as correct contours.
Foreign controls cover a finite set of known visible strokes. No contact with them cannot certify every possible future neighbor hop.
Large whole-word gaps, ambiguous fused glyph/contour strokes and arbitrary Hanja/Korean typography are not established by this experiment.
Previous unsuccessful outputs, source-control revisions and the immutable prior numeric/curve fixtures are preserved.
